messages:
Maya R: Vendor asked to align launch windows across H100/H200/MI300 but keep vendor-specific press dates. They want a single marketplace cutover and cross-region routing for MI300. Can we confirm risks?

Kevin C: Marketplace prefers one cutover date; we can hide visibility per SKU after publish. Need all image tags + driver hashes 72h before cutover.

Liu W: Note: H100 OEM partner has firmware embargo Apr 20-22. If we publish metadata early, must ensure visibility toggle respects their embargo.

Elena S: EU MI300 capacity is constrained Apr 18-24. We can offer US backfill but must document expected p99 latency delta for EU customers.

Priya N: SI partners request partner-only dry-run Apr 8-10. We'll need staging manifests by Apr 4. Can build hit that?

Maya R: Action list: 1) Build cuts staging images by Apr 4 (Liu/Tom), 2) Infra confirms MI300 EU nodes by Apr 2 (Elena), 3) Marketplace manifest + tags by Apr 10 (Kevin), 4) SI invites by Apr 5 (Priya).

Kevin C: I'll draft a short fallback line for comms if GA slips.

PartnerBot: Meeting scheduled "HW marketplace cutover sync" Tue Apr 7 11:00 PT. Invitations sent.

Maya R: Thanks all. Keep updates here; ping me for blockers.
